# Outputs

<!-- Generated by scripts/skill_outputs.py from outputs.yaml: do not edit by hand. -->

## Required outputs

| Output | Form | Recipient | Complete when |
|---|---|---|---|
| resolved-term-lane-or-gate | Chat reply, taken from the vocabulary table or its reference | The calling skill, its user | Each term has one meaning; Where two sources disagree, the SharePoint list wins |
| source-for-a-figure | Chat reply naming the list and export date | The calling skill | The figure is read live from the named list; No figure is stated without a nameable source |
| gate-route | Chat reply pointing to `dept-decision-rights` | `dept-decision-rights` | The gate is routed through "Who decides"; The decision stays with the named role |
| unresolved-marker | "to confirm" marker in the calling skill's output | The calling skill, the OD lead | A figure with no source or a term that does not resolve is marked and work stops there; The gap is not filled |

## Checks

| Output | Check | Sign-off |
|---|---|---|
| resolved-term-lane-or-gate | manual | The calling skill |
| source-for-a-figure | manual | The calling skill |
| gate-route | manual | OD lead |
| unresolved-marker | manual | The calling skill |

## Handoff

- **Next:** The spine serves every step; gates go to dept-decision-rights, and blocked work goes to the OD lead.: `dept-decision-rights`
- **Stops here when:** a term does not resolve or a figure has no source
- **Stops here when:** Mark it to confirm and stop
- **Stops here when:** It never writes to the knowledge graph or acts on an external machine connection
